title: Identify Your Dog Breed
subtitle: Upload a clear dog photograph and let DogBreedID analyze visual features using fine-grained Convolutional Neural Networks.

dropzone.title: Drag & drop your dog photo
dropzone.privacyNotice: Frontend demo: Your image is processed locally in this browser and is not uploaded to a server.
dropzone.supportedScope: DogBreedID predicts among supported Stanford Dogs breed classes.

tips.title: For Better Predictions
tips.tip1Desc: Ensure the dog's face and body are brightly lit without heavy shadow.
tips.tip2Desc: Photographs featuring a single dog provide higher classification confidence.
tips.tip3Desc: Ears, facial structure, coat texture, and muzzle angle assist feature mapping.
